heading: Is Rice-krispies gluten free?
intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Rice-krispies and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Rice Krispies are typically made from rice, which is gluten-free; however, there is a risk of cross-contamination with gluten-containing grains during processing. Additionally, some varieties may include barley malt, which contains gluten.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.body: Rice-krispies can vary by recipe, ingredients, and cross-contact controls in the kitchen.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
sections.body: Watch for hidden sources like soy sauce, malt flavoring, marinades, thickeners, and shared fryers.

faq.question: What should I ask a restaurant?
faq.answer: Ask about shared equipment, sauces, marinades, and whether the kitchen has a dedicated gluten-free prep area.
